🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) BELOW TREND and HYG above short-term (HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%)) provide independent confirmations while reflation (CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%)) supports cyclical outperformance.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) ↓ falling. Credit stress EASING: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) → flat. Reflation signal: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) ↑ rising while UUP BELOW TREND (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.48%) → flat; TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) shows duration weakness.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals/Value leading: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) and Materials (XLB proxy) ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%). Tech showing broad strength too: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%). Defensives lag: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%) and XLY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.84%).

5. US vs Global?
US outperformance: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) while EMs gaining: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +3.22%). China mixed: FXI RECOVERY (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.62%) and China vs US below trend.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Spec risk active but selective: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +2.91%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +3.10%) show appetite, while the Speculation Index is falling → mixed signals; IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +0.10%) remains supportive for crypto exposure.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals and industrial commodities leading: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) alongside CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) ↑ rising — reflation + safe-haven mix.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed but positive: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.61%) while oil and gas proxies showing short-term recoveries — BNO RECOVERY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) and UNG RECOVERY (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad equity strength with SPY, QQQ, XLK, XLF all ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: fixed income/credit shows RECOVERY pockets (LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%), BND RECOVERY) vs TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) — minor divergence to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/value and selective tech exposure given rotation: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) showing strength; reduce exposure to Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%) and monitor duration risk via TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials (XLB proxy) ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.44% | 1M: +8.35%), Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%), Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%). BEARISH: Utilities XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.99%), Consumer Discretionary XLY CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.84%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) and Copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%). BEARISH: Brent BNO RECOVERY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) and Natural Gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%) remain vulnerable on the 1M view.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 26.97 (VXX BELOW TREND) as a fear pivot; Credit Spread 0.7285 (flat/correction) for credit health; SPY/TLT 7.8677 ABOVE TREND as risk-on gauge; XLK/XLF 2.6345 (Tech vs Financials) monitoring rotation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) and HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) confirm risk-on tilt within a rotating market. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) and XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) showing relative strength. Key risk is bond-duration divergence—monitor TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) and RECOVERY readings in LQD/BND.
